correctness.rationale: Zero-temperature q=4,d=3 projective recursion leaves positive 2+2 ray [r:r:1:1] invariant with exact f(r)=(r³+2)/(2r³+1). Independent rational symbolic calculation shows f strictly decreasing, f(1)=1, and g=f²=(17r⁹+30r⁶+24r³+10)/(10r⁹+24r⁶+30r³+17), with g−r negative (r−1)³ times strictly positive factors on r>0. Hence even subsequences monotone toward only positive g fixed point 1, odd ones converge while alternating. Independent expansion g(1+u)=1+u−4u³/3+2u⁴/3+... gives u_(m+1)^−2−u_m^−2→8/3, hence m u_m²→3/8 and sqrt(n)|r_n−1|→sqrt(3)/2 (r0≠1). Convergence not extrapolated from finite experiments.
